title: Strong rate of convergence for the Euler--Maruyama scheme of SDEs with unbounded Hölder continuous drift coefficient
summary: In this paper, we provide the strong rate of convergence for the Euler--Maruyama scheme for multi-dimensional stochastic differential equations with uniformly locally (unbounded) Hölder continuous drift and multiplicative noise. Our technique is based on Itô--Tanaka trick (Zvonkin transformation) for unbounded drift. Moreover, in order to apply the stochastic sewing lemma, we use the heat kernel estimate for the density function of the Euler--Maruyama scheme.
